Developers are working hard on the game, sorry for no updates in the weekend, they were taking a break. 

Update #0.1.3

- Fixed impact sounds
- Fixed cars transmission (speed switching and gear rate)
- New changes to the current gamemode, added new defeat conditions (battle time, reinforcements)
- Fixed houses (Added loot)
- Fixed prone key (Should fix all the problems people had with not being able to prone)
- Fixed tents net distance
- Fixed repair and damage system of the tanks
- Fixed server list (Added battle time and name for the ranks)
- Fixed bots (respawn system)
- Fixed collision of the rocks
- Fixed PTRS animation
- Added village info widget
